{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the original trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the patient_id column
print("Unique patient_id values:", trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(trial_df))
print("Rows per patient (mean):", len(trial_df) / trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Group by patient_id and aggregate response
# Since response is binary, we use max to determine if patient responded at any time
patient_response = trial_df.groupby('patient_id').agg(
    treatment=('arm', lambda x: (x == 'treatment').iloc[0]),  # Treatment assignment per patient
    response=('responded', 'max')  # 1 if responded at any time
).reset_index()

# Verify the grouping
print("Patient-level data shape:", patient_response.shape)
print("Treatment group size:", patient_response['treatment'].sum())
print("Control group size:", (~patient_response['treatment']).sum())
print("Response rate overall:", patient_response['response'].mean())

# Cross-tabulate treatment and site
print("\nSite distribution by treatment:")
print(pd.crosstab(patient_response['site'], patient_response['treatment']))"}
